sentences.text: Date : 17-02-2020 Heard Mr. S. Chamaria, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Mr. B.
Sharma, learned Additional PP and Mr. D. Upamanyu, learned Standing counsel for the Health department.
The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to strike out the name of the respondent No.3 from the array of the parties.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the prosecution was initiated without considering as to whether the petitioner herein is a designated person under section Page No.# 3/3 66 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
